h1: Wellgrow Service House Chachoengsao — New Rooms Beside the Wellgrow Industrial Estate, Clean and Quiet on a Comfortable Budget
intro: If you're here to work or do business around the Wellgrow Industrial Estate in Bang Pakong — or just driving this route and want an affordable place to stop for the night — Wellgrow Service House is the new property that tops the area's review scores. It's a budget hotel in a new building that opened in 2025, sitting on a main road right by the Wellgrow estate in Phimpha. The draws are new, well-kept rooms, a quiet feel at night, and free parking. Rates start at about ฿700/night, which has earned it strong reviews among Chachoengsao's budget properties.

body.html: What lifts Wellgrow Service House's review scores is how new and clean it feels. The building only opened in 2025, so the rooms are still fresh, and guests repeatedly note that they're attractive, very clean and tastefully fitted out. Cleanliness ratings in real reviews reach the high 9s — which, for a property in the hundreds-to-low-thousands baht range beside an industrial estate, isn't easy to find. This is a place built around a clean, comfortable night on a budget rather than a full-service hotel.

Location is the main reason people stay here — it's right by the Wellgrow Industrial Estate in Phimpha, Bang Pakong, on a main road. That makes it a great fit for anyone coming to work, attend meetings or do business at the estate and wanting to stay close to the job rather than driving into central Chachoengsao. And because it sits on a main route, it's an easy overnight stop for anyone driving through the Bang Pakong–Chachoengsao area. The property's parking is free with plenty of space, which suits self-drivers.

Rooms come in a few types, from a king garden-view room and a single city-view room to a Signature room and a larger Deluxe Single Premium. Each has air-con, a flat-screen TV, a work desk, a rainfall shower and free Wi-Fi. The building has a lift, CCTV and the basic safety systems, plus a taxi-booking service. Overall the rooms are clean, simple and perfectly usable for a night or two, or for several nights while you're here for work.
"The room is beautiful, new and very clean, and it's quiet at night — a relaxing stay. Parking is easy, and it's great for anyone working near the estate. Excellent value for the price."

To be honest, there are a few things to set expectations on. The point guests raise most is food — the property serves no breakfast and has no on-site restaurant, and the nearby options are sparse, around a 5-7 minute drive away, so you'll want to bring your own or have a car. On top of that, because it sits by the road and near rice fields, some nights bring a few insects and a little road noise. In-room amenities are basic, and a few items such as a toothbrush may need to be brought yourself.

Overall, Wellgrow Service House holds a 9.1 out of 10 on Trip.com from 27 reviews, which is high for a budget property beside an industrial estate, and the praise consistently points to new, clean and quiet rooms. Weigh up the freshness, the cleanliness, free parking, a location right by the Wellgrow estate, and rates from around ฿700 that climb with the season and room type — and it does the job of a base for estate workers or passing drivers who want a clean night on a budget very neatly, as long as you plan ahead for food.
